fullDescription: A sophisticated, editorial-inspired legal litigation suite designed for professional attorneys and law firms. It features a high-contrast dark-mode sidebar, a neutral-light document management interface, and a focus on high-readability serif typography for legal documents. The aesthetic balances authoritative navy (#0a0a0a) and professional teal (#4e9eb8) with a structured, multi-pane layout. It is optimized for legal operations, fintech compliance, and document-heavy SaaS platforms requiring a 'hand-crafted' editorial feel rather than a generic grid-based UI.
prompt:
## Resumo
An editorial-grade legal professional interface featuring a three-pane layout, sophisticated serif-sans typography pairing, and a curated navy-teal color palette with significant whitespace for focus.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-end legal UI using 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for interfaces and 'Crimson Pro' for document content. Colors: Primary Navy (#0a0a0a), Accent Teal (#4e9eb8), Border Grey (#bababa), and Muted Grey (#626262). Body text in documents must use font-size: 17px with a line-height: 1.35. Headline weights should be font-weight: 700, while navigation uses font-weight: 500 or 600. Avoid excessive letter-spacing on body text; use 0.2em tracking only for uppercase labels. Borders should be 1px solid #bababa. Transitions for hover states: 0.2s ease. Document viewer should simulate a high-quality paper texture or pure white background with subtle shadow-sm.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Main Navigation Sidebar
Width: 64 units (256px). Background: #0a0a0a. Top section: Brand logo with Teal (#4e9eb8) icon and 'PRINCE LOBEL' in bold uppercase Jakarta Sans. Navigation groups: Sectioned by small uppercase headers with 0.2em tracking and 40% white opacity. Sidebar links: text-sm, 14px, 70% white opacity, with a 3px transparent left border that turns Teal (#4e9eb8) and background becomes 8% white opacity when active.

### Global Header
Height: 20 units (80px). Background: #ffffff. Border-bottom: 1px solid #bababa. Left side: A vertical Teal (#4e9eb8) bar (2px wide) preceding the Matter title ('Matter 2024-882-CIV') in font-bold text-xl. Right side: Multi-user avatars (32x32px squares) and a primary 'Action Center' button: background #0a0a0a, white text, uppercase text-[11px], bold, tracked widely.

### Document Inventory Panel
Width: 96 units (384px). Background: #f8f8f8. Border-right: 1px solid #bababa. Header: Small teal uppercase label 'ACTIVE DOCUMENT PANEL'. Cards: White background, 1px #bababa border. Document list items use 10px bold uppercase labels for file names with 10px muted gray metadata (e.g., 'EXHIBIT A-4'). Hover state: Border color changes to #4e9eb8.

### Document Viewer Hub
Background: #f0f0f0. Central container: max-width 3xl, white background, shadow-sm, 1px border. Inner padding: 80px horizontal, 112px vertical. Key Feature: A 4px solid Teal (#4e9eb8) vertical accent line running the full height of the left edge of the document container. Document typography: Crimson Pro, 17px, line-height 1.35. Annotations and version tags at footer: 10px bold uppercase tracking-widest.

### Intelligence & Analysis Sidebar
Width: 80 units (320px). Background: #ffffff. Border-left: 1px solid #bababa. Contains 'Verified Insights' cards with #f8f8f8 backgrounds and teal status icons. Bottom section: Dark contrast 'Drafting Assistant' box (Background #1e3d4d) containing a text-area with #0a0a0a background and a full-width #4e9eb8 'GENERATE DRAFT' button.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### The 'Paper' Viewport — A high-fidelity document previewer that mimics legal paper.
Container: white, border: 1px solid #bababa, shadow: subtle. Vertical Accent: 4px solid #4e9eb8 on far-left edge. Margins: px-20, py-28. Typography: 'Crimson Pro' serif, 17px. Headings: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', bold, uppercase, 24px, centered, with a 2px thick navy underline (12px wide) below the title.

### Citation Link — Styled hyperlink for legal case law within documents.
Color: #4e9eb8. Decoration: Underline. Font-weight: bold. Cursor: pointer. Example: 'Miller v. TechSystems (2019)'.

### Status Badge (Legal) — Small, authoritative badge for document status.
Text: 10px bold uppercase. Background: 10% opacity of #4e9eb8. Text color: #4e9eb8. Border: 1px solid 20% opacity of #4e9eb8. Padding: px-2, py-0.5.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain the 1.35 line-height for all 'Crimson Pro' serif blocks to ensure legal readability. MUST: Use sharp 1px borders (#bababa) between all panels to maintain the 'architectural' feel. DO NOT: Use rounded corners (keep borders 0px or very subtle). DO NOT: Use soft drop shadows; use borders for definition. DO NOT: Over-saturate; the only color should be Teal (#4e9eb8) and Navy (#0a0a0a).

style.description: The style emphasizes a 'hand-crafted' professional look. It pairs 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights 400-800) for UI/navigation with 'Crimson Pro' (weights 400-700) for legal document body text. Colors revolve around Deep Navy (#0a0a0a), Teal (#4e9eb8), and light grays (#f8f8f8, #bababa). Document reading areas use a 1.35 line-height for a natural reading rhythm. Micro-interactions are subtle, using 0.2s transitions on borders and text colors.
